summary: Appends one of two global string constants to the destination string a1: selects global a1 (0x005CD138) by default, switching to global a0 (0x005CD12C) when the byte at a2 is zero, then concatenates the selection onto a1 with strcat. Returns 0 unconditionally. Invoked by ConfigKeyValueSerialize (0x004B1C80) to serialize a config value as text; the a0/a1 globals are the two candidate text fragments chosen by the a2 byte.

local_names.a1: destination string that receives the appended text (also the name of read-global a1 in the decompiled body)
local_names.a2: flag byte: selects global a0 when it is zero, otherwise global a1
local_names.v2: selected global text fragment to append

operations.description: Default the text selection v2 to the read-global a1 (0x005CD138).
When the byte at a2 (*a2) is zero, switch the text selection to the read-global a0 (0x005CD12C).
strcat(a1, v2) appends the selected global text fragment to the destination string; strcat is an implicit CRT call not listed in the packet's callees.

unresolved: The contents of globals a0 (0x005CD12C) and a1 (0x005CD138) are not evidenced by the packet; docs/12 names them PrefixStringB and StringPrefixA (DERIVED), suggesting the a2 byte selects between two serialized-value text fragments, but that reading is unconfirmed.
strcat is reconstructed from the raw source text; it is an implicit CRT call with no packet callee evidence entry.
The decompiled body reuses the parameter name a1 for the read-global a1 (0x005CD138); the two referents are distinct.
